items.name: delete
items.description: delete a profile record from the database
items.acceptance: ProfileDao has a suspend fun delete(profile: Profile) annotated with @Delete

items.name: count
items.description: return the total number of profiles
items.acceptance: ProfileDao has a suspend fun count(): Int annotated with a @Query that counts rows
items.exact_code:
@Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profile")
    suspend fun count(): Int

items.name: deleteById
items.description: delete a profile by its id
items.acceptance: ProfileDao has a suspend fun deleteById(id: Long) annotated with a @Query DELETE statement
items.exact_code:
@Query("DELETE FROM profile WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun deleteById(id: Long)
